label: Bible Study
prompt: Consider the _____: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
verse: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
note: Consider the ravens — no storehouse, no barn, and God still feeds them.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But though he cause grief, yet will he have _____ according to the multitude of his mercies.
verse: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
note: Grief may come, but compassion follows — according to the multitude of His mercies.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was _____.
verse: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
note: 'Alas, master! for it was borrowed' — the axe head sank, and the worker's real worry was paying it back.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For ye are dead, and your life is _____ with Christ in God.
verse: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
note: Your real life is in safekeeping — hidden with Christ, as secure as a deposit in heaven's vault.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and _____ is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
verse: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
note: Samuel to Saul: rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and 'stubbornness' as idolatry. Disobedience is never small.
